ads.text: Google Ads Transparency: 24 live ads pointing at kehansrisolar.com, run by identity-verified advertiser AR07894673884648046593 (KehanSri Technologies & Service Pvt Ltd). Display image creatives plus a YouTube video creative.
Second creative family from the same verified account - a YouTube video ad, so the account is buying both Display and video inventory.

ad_library.summary: KehanSri is the heaviest live Google advertiser found in this sweep: 24 ads in Google's Ads Transparency Centre under a single identity-verified account (AR07894673884648046593), spanning Display image creatives and a YouTube video. The ads point at kehansrisolar.com, so unlike most of the Hyderabad field the spend does reach a page they own. Founded 2016, Gachibowli (Hyderabad 500032) with a registered office in Bhopal, and a 4.9 Google rating across 131 reviews - this is an established operator, not a lead-form-only reseller. No Meta Ad Library record was captured for this report; the evidence here is Google-only.

funnel.meaning: Every ad click lands on a page they own, which is the right structure - but the site still routes enquiry through a phone number and a form, and four of the five 'Read More' buttons on the homepage point at a staging host, so paid traffic can be sent into a half-finished build.

findings: 24 live Google ads behind one identity-verified account - the largest live Google ad count found in this sweep, and the only Hyderabad solar business here whose spend demonstrably reaches its own domain.

Four of the five homepage 'Read More' buttons point at the staging host www.wpstage.a2hosted.com/1411/kehanSri/ (roof-top, ground-mounted, operation-maintenance, project-management, EPC & development). Paid traffic clicking those buttons leaves the live site entirely.

The 'Know Your Solar Requirement' sizing table still quotes 300 Wp and 320 Wp modules and prices 3 kVA at INR 27,000 annual savings - 2024-era module data on a page doing the qualifying job for the ads.

The site carries real proof the ads do not use: named projects at 50 KW and 45 KW in Hyderabad, a 5 MW Hyderabad plant, 1.5 MW in Kolar (Karnataka), 100 KW in Mumbai and 1 MW in Ujjain, plus a 4.9/131-review Google rating.
Contact is phone-first (+91 888 628 6000) with info@kehansri.com published only on the contact page - there is no visible form-to-email routing test.
next_steps: Repoint the staging links before you scale spend
Four 'Read More' buttons send paid clicks to www.wpstage.a2hosted.com. Repointing them at the live pages is a five-minute fix that stops leaking the traffic you are already paying for.
The 300/320 Wp module figures and the INR 27,000-6,75,000 savings column are out of date. Current TOPCon modules change both the panel count and the payback story the table is used to sell.
Put the project list behind the ads
50 KW and 45 KW Hyderabad installs, 5 MW, 1.5 MW Kolar, 100 KW Mumbai, 1 MW Ujjain and a 4.9/131 rating are the strongest assets on the site and none of them appear in the ad creative.
Add a form that lands in a monitored inbox
Phone-first enquiry plus one buried email address means no record of who clicked and did not call. A form with a confirmed inbox gives you the retargeting pool.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
